environment.description: Same Spring Boot application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB in us-west-2. The task execution role has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:policy/PB-DenyTimingSensitiveExposure) attached. The permission boundary policy contains a Deny statement with condition key 'aws:RequestedRegion' restricting Secrets Manager access to only pre-warmed cached values via DAX-like sidecar proxy (envoy at 127.0.0.1:9901). Additionally, an SCP (id: scp-0a1b2c3d4e) on the OU denies sts:AssumeRole for any principal without MFA context, and the Fargate task networking uses awsvpc mode with a security group (sg-0f8e7d6c5b4a) that restricts ALL inbound to only the ALB security group on port 8443. The ALB has a listener rule with idle timeout of 30 seconds and connection draining enabled. The critical control: the ALB injects variable-latency processing via AWS-managed TLS negotiation and HTTP/2 multiplexing, and the security group blocks any direct TCP access that would bypass the ALB's non-deterministic request queuing behavior.

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate behind ALB (HTTP/2, TLS termination at ALB)
config.security_group_inbound: sg-0f8e7d6c5b4a: allow TCP/8443 from sg-alb-0x9y8z only
config.network_mode: awsvpc, no public IP, NAT gateway egress only
